verdict.rationale: Steel documents an explicit automatic CAPTCHA-solving stance: one session flag covers detection, solving, and verification (steel-docs-2, steel-docs-26), with dedicated Captchas API endpoints (steel-docs-13) and CAPTCHA solving listed as a core feature (steel-docs-11). A separate human-in-the-loop debug URL offers a documented manual path (steel-docs-5), but the evidence never ties it to CAPTCHA escalation. missing for 10: documented behavior when solving fails (error/status surfacing versus silent failure), an explicit CAPTCHA-to-human fallback workflow, a list of supported CAPTCHA types, independent or hands-on corroboration.
